meta.document: Fuel resource data (research draft, data only)
meta.note: Heat values are per mole of substance (amount of substance), not per mass. Burn rates are mol/s at 1x burn strength.

scales.burnRateDefinition: Design relative value in mol/s at 1x burn strength, anchored to real combustion/reactivity ordering (methane = 1.0 baseline). Nuclear is scaled up from real ~5e-6 mol/s for playability.
scales.coalMolarEquivalent: Standard coal is not a pure substance (29307 kJ/kg). Carbon-equivalent molar heat value = 29307 * 0.012011 ≈ 352 kJ/mol, treating 1 game-mole of coal as 1 mol of carbon-equivalent energy.

fuels.realHeatValueNote: Graphite standard molar enthalpy of combustion at 25C, 101kPa (C + O2 -> CO2).
fuels.realBurnRateRef: Solid surface oxidation; bulk combustion slow (cm/min scale), diffusion-limited.
fuels.intro: 最基础的单质燃料，燃烧平缓、能量密度低但易获取。

fuels.realHeatValueNote: Mass basis 29307 kJ/kg (7000 kcal/kg). Carbon-equivalent molar = 29307 * 0.012011 ≈ 351.9 kJ/mol.
fuels.realBurnRateRef: Pulverized/lump coal, diffusion-controlled, slow ignition and burnout.
fuels.intro: 工业时代能量货币，质量基准热值 29307 kJ/kg，能量密度偏低。

fuels.realHeatValueNote: Nuclear fission: ~200 MeV per fission * 6.022e23 / 1000 = 1.93e10 kJ/mol. EPFL (202.5 MeV) gives 1.954e10.
fuels.realBurnRateRef: Fission controlled by neutron flux; real consumption ~1 g U-235 per MW_th-day ≈ 5e-6 mol/s for a 1 GW reactor. Scaled up ~4000x for gameplay to 0.02 mol/s.
fuels.intro: 核裂变燃料，单摩尔能量是化学燃料的千万倍，受控缓慢释放。

fuels.realHeatValueNote: Nuclear fission: ~210 MeV per fission * 6.022e23 / 1000 = 2.03e10 kJ/mol (National Academies: 0.98 MWd/g vs U 0.95 MWd/g).
fuels.realBurnRateRef: Fission ~210 MeV/nucleus, same order as uranium, slightly higher. Scaled to 0.018 mol/s for gameplay (controlled fission).
fuels.intro: 人工核燃料，裂变能略高于铀，同属受控裂变、慢速高能量。

fuels.realHeatValueNote: Standard molar enthalpy of combustion (H2 + 1/2 O2 -> H2O(l)), 25C, 101kPa.
fuels.realBurnRateRef: Laminar burning velocity ~2.4-3.25 m/s (stoichiometric air, 1 atm); lowest minimum ignition energy among common fuels.
fuels.intro: 火焰传播极快、最易点燃的气体燃料，燃烧迅猛但单摩尔能量不高。

fuels.realHeatValueNote: Standard enthalpy of combustion (N2H4 + O2 -> N2 + 2 H2O(l)) ≈ -622 kJ/mol (NIST: -622.08 kJ/mol gas).
fuels.realBurnRateRef: Hypergolic (auto-ignites on contact), near-zero ignition delay; monopropellant decomposition very rapid.
fuels.intro: 火箭级自燃液体燃料，反应凶猛、能量密度高，易储运。

fuels.realHeatValueNote: Standard molar enthalpy of combustion HHV (CH4 + 2 O2 -> CO2 + 2 H2O(l)), 25C, 101kPa.
fuels.realBurnRateRef: Laminar burning velocity ~0.38-0.43 m/s (stoichiometric air, 1 atm); moderate.
fuels.intro: 基准气体燃料，单摩尔热值最高（化学燃料），燃烧温和稳定。
